evidence: The complete native Windows x64 module passes 15/15 on exact commit 5a76725c using the locally signed packaged LPAC worker and newly frozen Core guardian. The two R01-F01 regressions enter the broker before exceeding a one-second wall deadline and a 256 MiB committed-memory Job limit. They assert typed timeout or truncated-pipe failure, signaled worker termination, guardian exit, exact profile and runtime removal, an intact unrelated sentinel, and no successful WorkerResult. A bounded 320 MiB host positive control confirms memory is available outside the worker Job.

The 68 focused Core connector tests include a protected SQLite durable content-free plugin-worker-failed audit after a synthetic worker exception, reopened by invocation and package identity, with zero output-store writes. Native exhaustion and durable dispatch-audit proofs are seam-composed through the production launcher/dispatch call path; direct OS-denied operations caught inside the untrusted worker are not individually observable or audited. R01's signed isolation, broker, guardian and previous adverse gate evidence remain attached and independently reviewed.

The exact R02 candidate passes 68 focused Core connector tests, including encrypted-state migration/reopen, consent, grant and package restart, denial, cancellation and fenced staging; the new failure audit test verifies denial survives a repository reopen. The full signed native module passes 15/15 including two new resource-exhaustion cases. Frozen Core package and six packaging tests pass, with one expected environment skip.

No product or desktop UI source changed after R01. Its committed R01 submission and independent review retain the exact earlier full desktop application qualification, nine commands and 72 style cases. Desktop/profile-wide replay is deferred to S05 slice integration and W2 qualification under verification breadth section 8.1.

The strict-descendant R02 diff preserves R01's reviewed product and authority boundaries, updates the missed task-start failure-proof row, adds real signed-worker wall/memory regressions, and adds the protected durable failure-audit regression. The original R01 adverse finding and its evidence remain immutable; this submission asks the independent reviewer to replay and close F01.

Exact-candidate Python quality (516 files), architecture, generated Core API contract and clean build manifest pass. The frozen Core/guardian builds with 783 files and the locally signed worker inventory; no approved scope, security, migration or governed-experience reduction is claimed. Test signing and synthetic broker transport are not production signing or a live public-route result.
